1.consolidated_definition: Medicamento a base de cloruro con alto porciento de cloro que se aplica para detener la sangre cuando el gallo es herido por su contrincante o cuando es armado y se le cortan las espuelas. En el argot de los galleros se escucha la variante petroduro por falsa etimología.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medicine based on chlorinated compound with high chlorine content that is applied to stop bleeding when a rooster is injured by its opponent or when it is armed and its spurs are cut off. In the argot of cockfighters, the variant petroduro is heard due to false etymology.
